text:
paul: Noticed ~90 objects in prod-backups bucket uploaded w/ SSE-S3 instead of SSE-KMS around 03:14 UTC. Likely from backup job.

anya: Which principal did the puts? I'll grep CloudTrail.

encops-bot: Alert INV-2026-04-02-09: s3 PutObject without aws:kms detected (count=90).

ben: CloudTrail shows calls from arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/backup-agent-runner at 03:10-03:20. Recent PR renamed role and removed kms:Encrypt in its policy.

paul: Ok stop the scheduled backup job now (disable via infra service). We should block further non-KMS uploads with a bucket policy deny (test in staging first).

anya: Proposed deny snippet: 
```
{ "Sid":"DenyNonKMS", "Effect":"Deny", "Principal":"*", "Action":"s3:PutObject", "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::prod-backups/*", "Condition":{ "StringNotEquals":{"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption":"aws:kms"} } }
```

ben: For remediation, small-scale re-encrypt using S3 copy-in-place w/ REPLACE metadata. Example: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://prod-backups/snap-20260402-0314.tar.gz \
  s3://prod-backups/snap-20260402-0314.tar.gz \
  --metadata-directive REPLACE --server-side-encryption aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd
```

paul: Run a pilot of 10 objects with throttling to avoid KMS QPS spikes. Also confirm key policy grants `backup-agent-runner` and s3 service if needed.

compliance: I'll prep the customer notification checklist. Any customer data in these snapshots? If yes, we follow data incident escalation.

encops-bot: INC-1890 created. Assigned: anya, ben. ETA pilot run: 45m.
